3. Using the 9 slime balls from step 2, craft 3 slime balls to have enough for the next steps.
4. Use the 3 slime balls to craft 1 slime block.
5. Use the 1 slime block from step 4 to craft 1 slime ball.
6. Craft 1 blaze powder using 1 blaze rod. We will make the blaze rod next.
7. Craft 1 blaze rod using 1 potion ingredient and 1 blaze powder.
8. To get the potion ingredient, we need to craft 1 popper chorus fruit using 1 chorus fruit.
9. Craft 1 chorus fruit using 1 melon slice.
10. Craft 1 melon slice using 4 carrot.
11. Collect 4 carrot and craft 1 melon slice.
12. Craft 1 popper chorus fruit using 1 melon slice from step 10.
13. Craft 1 blaze rod using 1 popper chorus fruit from step 12 and 1 potion ingredient which we've already made.
14. Craft 1 blaze powder using 1 blaze rod from step 13.
15. Craft 4 end rod using 1 popped chorus fruit from step 11 and 1 blaze rod from step 13. This also gives us 1 slime ball from the popped chorus fruit.
16. Craft 1 magma cream using 1 blaze powder from step 14 and 1 slime ball from step 15.
